title: Divisibility is an order, gcd and lcm are meet and join
lede: The divisors of n, drawn with one edge for each multiplication by a prime. Click divisors: the last click lights its divisors (teal) and its multiples (gold).
notice: For 30 the divisors form a cube: each of the three directions is a prime that is either in the number or not.
The gcd of two clicked divisors is the highest vertex below both, and the lcm is the lowest vertex above both. Both are ringed.
The readout finds them from the order alone and confirms they match the usual gcd and lcm formulas. For 210 the 4D cube is projected into 3D.
hint: Click a divisor. Drag to rotate.
